harness_limitations: Initial auth commands were expected to be rejected but actually succeeded; expectations were corrected using explicit old/new password readbacks.
First traffic probe found capture disabled; enabled owned traffic capture before real loopback request.
First CTRL_C harness attempt used forced termination after signal did not close child. It is not cancellation evidence.
A bounded --timeout probe was inapplicable because SSE intentionally has no total request timeout; subprocess timeout killed that owned stream.
Final CTRL_BREAK attempts all exited without forced termination, but exit1 instead of130.
Transient harness exceptions remain in assertions.json; they are not product failures. Final product finding is the three stream interrupt exit-code failures.
